creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-05 building the captured-mouse link fix (4173bb80). Run back to back, SurfaceGUITests fixtures can fail to find a visible OSC 8 link even though a search finds its label; the same case run alone passes. Waiting for renderer.freesInFlight == 0 between fixtures makes the whole matrix pass in either order, and 4173bb80's fixtures do that wait. Cause unknown: it may be a lifecycle race in the product (a surface made while the previous one's teardown is in flight), not only in the test, so the wait is a workaround, not an explanation. Repro notes were in the worker's scratch files (/private/tmp/muster-slot2-link-debug.log) on the Mac mini.
title: A real-surface test that follows another can find no OSC 8 link where its label is
